summary: Tested new AI Team feature (12 owner-only agents + Forge builder) end-to-end. 9/10 backend tests pass; frontend fully functional. Blocking issue: Forge build reproducibly fails because the Sonnet site-HTML call in run_forge_build times out at 240s with no fallback.

critical.issue: Forge job reliably fails at the 'building' step. services/agents.py:195 calls _call_llm(_build_site_prompt(...), GEN_BUILD_SYSTEM, BUILD_MODEL) directly with BUILD_MODEL='claude-sonnet-4-6'. services/llm.py wraps every call in asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=LLM_CALL_TIMEOUT_S=240). Sonnet HTML generation regularly exceeds 240s and raises TimeoutError, killing the job. The regular generation flow (services/llm.py lines 163-178) has a Sonnet->Haiku fallback on TimeoutError, but run_forge_build does not — so Forge has no safety net. Reproduced twice in a row (jobs forge_f0f90663b8 and forge_aaa93325c8 both errored ~4:50 into build). Backend log clearly shows: 'forge build failed ... TimeoutError' at services/agents.py:195.

minor.issue: On failure, only str(e) is stored. For asyncio TimeoutError str(e) is '' so DB doc has {status: 'error', error: ''} and the UI toast/status is empty. Store repr(e) or e.__class__.__name__ + ': ' + str(e).

issues: DashboardLayout.jsx and AiTeam.jsx both treat role==='admin' as 'owner' (isOwner = role==='owner' || role==='admin'), so an admin user sees the 'AI Team' nav and reaches /team, but the backend gates every /api/agents endpoint via security.is_owner (owner-only). Result: admin sees empty roster + toast errors. Either broaden backend gate to admin, or tighten frontend to owner-only.

action_items: Fix Forge build timeout: wrap the Sonnet site-build in try/except asyncio.TimeoutError with a Haiku fallback (mirror services/llm.py:163-178), or raise LLM_CALL_TIMEOUT_S for BUILD_MODEL calls, or split the HTML build into smaller Sonnet calls.
Store meaningful error text in agent_jobs when the build fails (repr(e) instead of str(e)).
Decide policy for admin role vs owner on /team: either allow admin in backend (is_owner) or exclude admin in DashboardLayout.jsx + AiTeam.jsx (currently frontend lets admin in, backend blocks them).
critical_code_review_comments: run_forge_build has no timeout/fallback safety net — a single slow Sonnet call bricks the whole job.
Empty error strings stored in agent_jobs make debugging impossible from UI.
Owner/admin role divergence between frontend gate and backend gate.
services/agents.py file is fine size-wise; no DRY violations spotted.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (owner nav, roster of 12, chat, quick actions, Forge panel open, clear chat, non-owner gating + redirect all pass)

rca of the issue: Forge build error root cause: services/agents.py run_forge_build → line 195 → services/llm.py _call_llm with BUILD_MODEL (claude-sonnet-4-6) inside asyncio.wait_for(timeout=240). Sonnet's full-site HTML generation for a Forge template consistently exceeds 240s → asyncio.TimeoutError → caught in run_forge_build's outer except → job marked 'error' with empty message (str(TimeoutError())=''). The main /api/templates generation path (services/llm.py:163-178) already handles this by catching TimeoutError from Sonnet and retrying with Haiku — Forge lacks this fallback. Reproduction: POST /api/agents/forge/build as owner with any non-trivial brief; poll GET /api/agents/jobs/{id} — reaches status='building', then flips to status='error' at ~4-5 min. Mitigation: mirror the fallback pattern from services/llm.py inside run_forge_build's building step.
